summary: Verified mobile Welcome footer compactness fix at phone widths. The fix significantly reduced footer height from ~1485px to 1121px at 390x844, but two gap metrics still exceed targets: socialGap (44px vs <=28px target) and linksGap (31px vs <=24px target). At 430px width, the useDensePhoneFooter flag is not active, causing footer to revert to 1450px height. Non-regression checks for tablet/desktop centering and no horizontal overflow all pass.
